title: Existing solutions: staying home, companionship and care breaks
scope: Germany-first desk research across seven existing reviewed situations
decision: Need → specific situation → existing solutions. Informal workarounds remain supporting evidence, not solution-map nodes.
method: Searched official provider sources and opened each included source page beyond search snippets. Verified described offerings, not customer availability, outcomes or endorsement.
verification_limitations: Current means the provider currently describes the offering; live capacity was not contacted or booked.
Prices reflect pages accessed on research date; benefits and legal entitlement were not independently adjudicated.
No images were downloaded; image licensing and visual review remain separate.
No new prevalence, demand, unmet-need or underserved-market claims are supported by these records.
